title: TRIZ principle 7 — nesting
problem_statement: Objects waste space when stored or shipped. The problem is documented and scoped before any solution work begins.
concept: Nest objects inside each other: Russian dolls, telescoping antennas, nested tables. Space collapses when not in use. Validation emphasis: the listed validation plan is the next work — run the cheapest discriminating test first.
validation_plan: Measure packed vs deployed volume for 3 products
Document the outcome honestly whether it confirms or kills the concept.
